Alex Chen: Heads up 52555 - payroll vendor change on 7/15. Quick Q: if I set 401(k) catch-up as Roth in benefits portal, will Pinnacle import it as separate line or merge with my regular deferral?
Maria Gomez: Good question. Can you share your employee ID so payroll can look up mapping?
Alex Chen: ID 3472. Also curious about the mid-month payroll cutover: last BrightPay pay on 7/9, first Pinnacle on 7/23. How do YTD catch-up amounts get preserved? :thinking_face: 
Jamal Singh: Hi Alex 28 payroll here. Pinnacle expects a separate contribution code for catch-up. We usually send BrightPay YTD figures on the transfer. If there's any mismatch we create an adjustment on the first Pinnacle payroll.
Jamal Singh: TL;DR: catch-up stays its own line item, tax type follows the election (Roth vs pre-tax).
Maria Gomez: @Jamal can you confirm if BrightPay export includes separate YTD fields for "catch-up"? We need to avoid hitting the IRS additional catch-up limit.
Jamal Singh: BrightPay export shows YTD contributions but sometimes vendors lump amounts. I'll pull the export for 3472 and reconcile.
Pinnacle Payroll Bot: Notice: import scheduled 2024-07-16 02:00 UTC. Auto-verify YTD balances: enabled.
Alex Chen: Also planning unpaid parental leave 8/1-8/31. If I'm not paid that month, does catch-up get paused or prorated?
Maria Gomez: Contributions pause during unpaid leave. You can elect to make up contributions later in the year if you want to hit the $7,500 catch-up (example number). Our plan allows make-up contributions, subject to payroll entry timing.
Jamal Singh: Options: (1) Front-load catch-up before leave, (2) Resume and backfill after return, (3) Manual one-time entry later in year. We can set a one-off contribution in Pinnacle as needed.
Alex Chen: If I elect Roth catch-up now and then make a make-up in Nov, will that make-up be Roth too?
Jamal Singh: Yes 28 tax treatment follows contribution type on the payroll entry. If you ask for Roth, the one-off will be posted as Roth catch-up. We'll add a note in payroll record to avoid confusion.
Maria Gomez: Action items: JAMAL - reconcile BrightPay export for 3472 and set adjustment if needed; MARIA - update benefits FAQ with a short note about mid-month vendor cutovers + unpaid leave + catch-up makeups.
People Ops (bot): Action created: @Jamal Singh to reconcile BrightPay export for employee 3472 and set Pinnacle adjustment if needed. Due 2024-07-16.
Alex Chen: Thanks. If you need a signed authorization to change election or make a manual contribution, ping me and I'll return the form same day. :thumbsup:
Jamal Singh: Will do. I'll post back once import runs and we confirm the mapping and any manual adjustment. :eyes:
